about: SYNTHETIC DATA. Sample tickets for the interface (block 6): case ID, short title, ticket text and reported time (UTC) only. Copied from cases/scenarios/index.json. No expected results, no human answers and no real company or case names, so the interface never reads the answer key. A test checks this file against the index.

samples.title: Failed platform migration
samples.ticket: Since the platform migration on Saturday night (15 Feb, 22:00), customers can't log into online or mobile banking and payments fail. Call centre queues are over an hour.

samples.title: Failed client migration
samples.ticket: Clients have been locked out of their accounts since the client migration started on Saturday at 22:00. Online and mobile banking problems, call centres overwhelmed, complaints piling up.

samples.title: Settlement platform outage
samples.ticket: Large-value euro payments can't settle since 09:00. The EuroSettle platform is down for all participants, not just us. Cut-offs are being pushed back.

samples.title: Three-day software fault
samples.ticket: Since 07:30 the app and online banking are failing for many customers. More than half of online payments fail. It's month-end payday.

samples.title: Card processor hardware fault
samples.ticket: Card payments are failing in shops since 14:35, in Germany and abroad. CardNet reports a data centre problem.

samples.title: Ransomware on securities settlement
samples.ticket: Securities settlement servers were encrypted overnight, there's a ransom note on screen. We can't settle trades for counterparties.

samples.title: Ransomware at the derivatives vendor
samples.ticket: ClearPath says it was hit by ransomware. Our derivatives clearing has been down since 07:00 and staff are processing trades by hand.

samples.title: DDoS attack
samples.ticket: Massive traffic flood on our network since 16:30. Online banking is down, ATMs and card payments are having problems.

samples.title: Wrong balances after a software fault
samples.ticket: App, online and phone banking failing since 17:00. Some customers can withdraw more than their balance. Queues at ATMs.

samples.title: Cloud data breach found months later
samples.ticket: An outside researcher tipped us off: credit application data from our cloud environment is being shared online. Logs show access since March.

samples.title: Breach at the file transfer vendor
samples.ticket: SecureDrop, our file transfer vendor, says attackers exploited a flaw in its software and copied files. Our customer files were among them.

samples.title: Ransomware first read as a hardware fault
samples.ticket: Core banking systems not working properly since 08:00. Batch jobs are failing, it looks like a storage hardware failure.

samples.title: Breach at a software supplier's file platform
samples.ticket: Fintegra warns that an attacker accessed the file transfer platform it uses to send us files. They don't know yet if our files were affected.

samples.title: Outsourcer fault with a payment backlog
samples.ticket: SEPA transfers and direct debits stopped at 09:30 because of a fault at Rhein IT Services. Unprocessed payment files are still turning up.

samples.title: Outsourcer fault hits online banking
samples.ticket: Online banking has been down since around noon, email too. Rhein IT Services reports a technical fault.

samples.title: Planned release, finished on time
samples.ticket: The mobile app has been unavailable since Saturday 18:00. Is this the release weekend?

samples.title: Planned release that overran
samples.ticket: Online banking is still not back on Monday at 08:00. The release window ended at 06:00.

samples.title: Faulty security update, office laptops
samples.ticket: Office laptops crash with a blue screen after a security software update since 06:10. Online banking and payments are running normally.

samples.title: Faulty security update, payment workstations
samples.ticket: Payment operations workstations in Duesseldorf and Vienna crash after a security software update since 06:10. Payments are queuing.

samples.title: HR portal slow
samples.ticket: HR portal is slow this morning.

samples.title: Short online banking blip
samples.ticket: Online banking was unavailable for about 40 minutes from 14:00 this afternoon. A handful of complaints.

samples.title: Payments down 3 hours, nothing else
samples.ticket: Outgoing SEPA payments stopped from 10:00 to 13:00, then were processed normally.

samples.title: Phishing click, no access
samples.ticket: An employee clicked a phishing link this morning. Security says the login was blocked.

samples.title: Short outage, costly and in the news
samples.ticket: Card payments failed for 90 minutes from 12:00 during the Saturday shopping peak. National news covered it. Vendor support and refunds will cost about 140,000 euros.

samples.title: Exactly 10% of clients
samples.ticket: Mobile banking login has been failing for part of the app users since 11:00.

samples.title: Brief example: online banking down
samples.ticket: Online banking down since 9:10, customers can't log in.

samples.title: Brief example: large data transfer at night
samples.ticket: SOC flagged a large data transfer at 2 a.m.
